scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run test:watch --prefix server" "npm run test:watch --prefix client"
